{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in both biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)
df['biomarker_final'] = df['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Drop rows where either baseline or final biomarker is missing
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final'])

# Compute the change in biomarker (follow-up - baseline)
df_clean['change'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the average change across all patients in the clean dataset
average_change = df_clean['change'].mean()

total_patients_included = len(df_clean)

print(average_change)
print(total_patients_included)"}
